body: ### Reproduction steps I am having trouble getting dev containers to start, with the configuration in this [project on GitHub](https://github.com/blkerby/MapRandomizer/commit/63d8d9a07d2b62597fcf7e92ada537ec51c31929). When there is an existing container, successfully created by opening VSCode with the same `.devcontainer` config, I get this error when opening Zed and selecting "Yes, Open in Container": ``` 2026-04-13T15:49:17-06:00 ERROR [dev_container::docker] Non-success result from docker pull: Error response from daemon: pull access denied for eebe9773723d, repository does not exist or may require 'docker login' 2026-04-13T15:49:17-06:00 ERROR [dev_container::docker] Error deserializing metadata: invalid type: map, expected a sequence at line 1 column 0 2026-04-13T15:49:17-06:00 ERROR [dev_container::command_json] Error running command Command("docker" "inspect" "--format={{json . }}" "eebe9773723d"): Error deserializing from raw json: invalid type: map, expected a sequence at line 1 column 0 2026-04-13T15:49:17-06:00 ERROR [recent_projects::remote_servers] Failed to start dev container: DevContainerUpFailed("Failed with nested error: CommandFailed(\"docker\")") ``` Here `eebe9773723d` is the container ID, so of course `docker pull` would fail when given a container ID instead of image reference. If I remove the existing container and reopen Zed, I get a different error: ``` 2026-04-13T16:03:42-06:00 ERROR [dev_container::devcontainer_manifest] docker buildx build failed: #0 building with "default" instance using docker driver #1 [internal] load build definition from Dockerfile.extended #1 transferring dockerfile: 5.13kB done #1 DONE 0.1s #2 [context dev_containers_feature_content_source] load .dockerignore #2 transferring dev_containers_feature_content_source: #2 transferring dev_containers_feature_content_source: 2B done #2 DONE 0.1s #3 [auth] library/dev_container_auto_added_stage_label:pull token for registry-1.docker.io #3 DONE 0.0s #4 [internal] load metadata for docker.io/library/dev_container_auto_added_stage_label:latest #4 ERROR: pull access denied, repository does not exist or may require authorization: server message: insufficient_scope: authorization failed ------ > [internal] load metadata for docker.io/library/dev_container_auto_added_stage_label:latest: ------ Dockerfile.extended:103 -------------------- 101 | 102 | 103 | >>> FROM $_DEV_CONTAINERS_BASE_IMAGE AS dev_containers_feature_content_normalize 104 | USER root 105 | COPY --from=dev_containers_feature_content_source ./devcontainer-features.builtin.env /tmp/build-features/ -------------------- ERROR: failed to build: failed to solve: dev_container_auto_added_stage_label: failed to resolve source metadata for docker.io/library/dev_container_auto_added_stage_label:latest: pull access denied, repository does not exist or may require authorization: server message: insufficient_scope: authorization failed 2026-04-13T16:03:42-06:00 ERROR [recent_projects::remote_servers] Failed to start dev container: DevContainerUpFailed("Failed with nested error: CommandFailed(\"docker\")") ``` I am using a multi-stage Docker build here, not sure if that matters. ### Current vs. Expected behavior ### Zed version and system specs Zed: v0.232.2+preview.223.5d57a5a27c01ad860d1936866133f14856fde55d (Zed Preview) OS: Linux Wayland ubuntu 25.10 Memory: 30.3 GiB Architecture: x86_64 GPU: Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (RPL-P) || Intel open-source Mesa driver || Mesa 25.2.8-0ubuntu0.25.10.1 I got errors with the stable version as well (0.231.2) ### Attach Zed log file _No response_ ### Relevant Zed
